parts.name: barrel shell

physics.Basic_description: White cylindrical main body tube with a smooth matte finish.
physics.Functional_description: Houses the batteries and connects the head to the tail cap.
physics.Grasped_description: Primary grasp location; gripper fingers close around the cylindrical midsection.
physics.reason: Standard flashlight construction uses a thin-walled tube to enclose batteries and electronics.

parts.description: White cylindrical main body tube with a smooth matte finish.
parts.function: Houses the batteries and connects the head to the tail cap.

parts.name: shoulder shell

physics.Basic_description: White conical transition section connecting the narrow barrel to the wider head.
physics.Functional_description: Structural transition that flares out to support the larger reflector head.
physics.Grasped_description: Can be grasped, but the taper may cause the gripper to slip towards the barrel.
physics.reason: Continuous shell structure with the barrel, enclosing empty space or wiring.

parts.description: White conical transition section connecting the narrow barrel to the wider head.
parts.function: Structural transition that flares out to support the larger reflector head.

parts.name: tail cap

physics.Basic_description: Dark grey flat circular cap at the rear end of the flashlight.
physics.Functional_description: Seals the battery compartment and often acts as a power switch button.
physics.Grasped_description: Gripper can press against the flat face or grasp the rim to unscrew.
physics.reason: Likely a solid rubber boot or thick plastic plug designed for impact absorption and sealing.

parts.description: Dark grey flat circular cap at the rear end of the flashlight.
parts.function: Seals the battery compartment and often acts as a power switch button.

parts.name: clip mount

physics.Basic_description: Small yellow ring or band around the barrel where the clip attaches.
physics.Functional_description: Mounting point or retention ring for the pocket clip.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and flush to be a primary grasp target; avoid gripping here to prevent damage.
physics.reason: Appears as a solid retaining ring or molded feature on the shell.

parts.description: Small yellow ring or band around the barrel where the clip attaches.
parts.function: Mounting point or retention ring for the pocket clip.

parts.name: pocket clip

physics.Basic_description: Orange curved strip attached to the side of the barrel.
physics.Functional_description: Allows the flashlight to be clipped onto a pocket or belt.
physics.Grasped_description: Flexible and prone to breaking; gripper should avoid applying force directly to it.
physics.reason: Thin but solid strip of material, not enclosing a volume.

parts.description: Orange curved strip attached to the side of the barrel.
parts.function: Allows the flashlight to be clipped onto a pocket or belt.

parts.name: head shell

physics.Basic_description: Purple/white wide cylindrical housing at the front containing the light components.
physics.Functional_description: Protects the reflector and LED assembly and provides heat dissipation surface area.
physics.Grasped_description: Wide diameter offers a stable grasp, though ribs might reduce contact area slightly.
physics.reason: Encloses the reflector and electronics; must be hollow to function.

parts.description: Purple/white wide cylindrical housing at the front containing the light components.
parts.function: Protects the reflector and LED assembly and provides heat dissipation surface area.

parts.name: reflector

physics.Basic_description: Silver/grey faceted cone visible inside the head opening.
physics.Functional_description: Shapes and directs the light beam from the LED.
physics.Grasped_description: Internal component; not accessible for grasping without disassembly.
physics.reason: Reflectors are thin spun metal or vacuum-metallized plastic shells.

parts.description: Silver/grey faceted cone visible inside the head opening.
parts.function: Shapes and directs the light beam from the LED.

parts.name: led emitter

physics.Basic_description: Tiny central component at the base of the reflector (obscured/small).
physics.Functional_description: Generates the light output.
physics.Grasped_description: Micro-component; strictly non-graspable.
physics.reason: Solid state electronic component mounted on a substrate.

parts.description: Tiny central component at the base of the reflector (obscured/small).
parts.function: Generates the light output.

parts.name: lens disc

physics.Basic_description: Transparent or slightly blue-tinted flat disc covering the front opening.
physics.Functional_description: Protects the internal reflector and LED from dust and moisture while transmitting light.
physics.Grasped_description: Smooth and fragile; gripper should not press directly on the glass surface.
physics.reason: Optical element is a solid pane of glass or polycarbonate.

parts.description: Transparent or slightly blue-tinted flat disc covering the front opening.
parts.function: Protects the internal reflector and LED from dust and moisture while transmitting light.

parts.name: front bezel ring

physics.Basic_description: Lime green/yellow ring at the very front edge of the flashlight head.
physics.Functional_description: Retains the lens and protects the edge of the head from impacts.
physics.Grasped_description: Can be grasped, but it is a thin ring; better to grasp the head shell behind it.
physics.reason: Ring structure surrounding the lens opening.

parts.description: Lime green/yellow ring at the very front edge of the flashlight head.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained

simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)
